title: CognitionBioChem: A structural pharmacology workbench that reports a negative result
description:
A structural pharmacology workbench for cognition-related CNS targets, built around the discipline that a displayed number must trace to a computation. Boltz-2 v2.2.1 runs locally and produced every predicted structure; chemistry is validated with RDKit; every value carries a provenance record, and fields that were never computed render as labels rather than figures. Eight studies were pre-registered under content hashes before any data was seen, and their artefacts, analysis plans and prediction runs are all under content-addressed custody in the repository.

The headline result is negative, and is the reason the project exists in this form. Across a 13-candidate screen and a 143-fold full-MSA rerun, designed peptides did not separate from composition-matched shuffles of their own amino acids: mean native ipTM 0.629 against a mean decoy of 0.628. That hypothesis has been falsified in all eleven retained versions of the two screening studies, across candidate sets from six to thirteen designs.

An earlier version of this project displayed fabricated affinity, confidence and safety values as though they had been computed. Those claims are preserved under retracted_claims rather than deleted, and the renderers that produced them are gone. The repository ships 51 structures it computed or downloaded, 8 study artefacts, 26 registered analysis plans and 313 automated checks that are themselves verified to fail on the defects they name.

Development note: this project was built with substantial AI assistance, and its internal review was a multi-agent LLM process rather than human peer review. Both facts are stated in the README and NOTICE.
